import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
inp,out=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def transform(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    # find markers (nonzero not 5)
    mk=[(v,i,j) for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (0,5)]
    (c1,i1,j1),(c2,i2,j2)=sorted(mk,key=lambda m:m[2])
    # frame bounds
    fi=[i for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==5]
    fj=[j for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==5]
    r0,r1,c0,c1_=min(fi),max(fi),min(fj),max(fj)
    mi=(r0+r1+1)//2; mj=(c0+c1_+1)//2
    quads={'TL':(r0+1,mi,c0+1,mj),'TR':(r0+1,mi,mj,c1_),'BL':(mi,r1,c0+1,mj),'BR':(mi,r1,mj,c1_)}
    for q,(rs,re_,cs,ce) in quads.items():
        val = c1 if q in ('TL','BR') else c2
        for i in range(rs,re_):
            for j in range(cs,ce): a[i][j]=val
    return a
res=[transform(tuple(map(tuple,inp)))]
print(res[0]==out)
print(res[0])
test=transform(tuple(map(tuple,G['Test input'])))
print(json.dumps([list(r) for r in test]))
